title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC mins (Jul 28-29) released 19:00 BST: 9-3 hold confirmed; broader hawkish sympathy beyond 3 dissenters noted, Warsh non-committal. Sept hold odds ~65%.
White House crypto summit convened: Trump, SEC/CFTC chairs, Coinbase, Ripple on CLARITY Act — CFTC Innovation Committee formally launched.
No price threshold breaches — BTC $64,170 (-0.5% 24h), ETH $1,917 (+0.3%), DXY 98.97 (-0.69%).
